title: QR Drop - GNOME Extension
description: Just Copy (Ctrl+C) & Click – instant QR code generation from clipboard. A lightweight tool built for Linux users to solve PC-to-Mobile transfer friction. 100% Offline & Private.
challenges: Understanding the GNOME Shell architecture and handling Clipboard API asynchronously was challenging. Also, drawing QR codes using Cairo graphics required precise coordinate calculations.
futurePlans: I plan to add support for Wi-Fi credential sharing via QR code and implement a history feature to access previously generated codes.

title: AssetVerse
description: A comprehensive asset management system. Users can track, manage, and monitor company assets with real-time updates and reporting features.
challenges: Managing real-time state updates across multiple users and implementing a complex search/filter system for assets was the main hurdle.
futurePlans: Integration with barcode scanners for physical asset tracking and generating PDF reports for monthly audits.

title: TravelEase
description: A travel booking platform designed for seamless user experience. Features include destination browsing, booking management, and user reviews.
challenges: Ensuring secure user authentication (JWT) and optimizing database queries for faster search results were significant challenges.
futurePlans: Adding a payment gateway integration (Stripe/SSLCommerz) and an AI-based trip planner feature.

title: Quiz.IO
description: An interactive quiz application where users can test their knowledge across various categories. Features real-time scoring and time limits.
challenges: Handling timer synchronization and preventing users from reloading the page during a quiz session required careful state management.
futurePlans: Implementing a multiplayer mode where friends can compete against each other in real-time.
